remarks: Lakeshore Realty is proud to present for sale 158 East Avenue in Norwalk, CT. This is a fabulous opportunity for an owner/user. The property features a new roof, sub-roof, and gutters (2019) and many other recent improvements including a security system and hardwired fire alarm, Nest thermostat, new oil tank and plumbing in basement, upgraded electrical panels, irrigation system, central A/C systems on both floors, chimney and stainless steel liner, general interior upgrades, and a new water main line from the street to basement.  The office features a reception area, 9-10 offices, a kitchen, open space with natural light, a full basement, and two bathrooms.
